t: Signature Edge Impulse: What Edge Impulse Is and Why It Exists
title: Signature Edge Impulse: What Edge Impulse Is and Why It Exists
description: The Signature counterpart is the SigTiny Foundry, Manon's original design for a self-contained tinyML workbench. Where the public platform centers on a hosted studio, the Foundry centers on a local-first pipeline file: one signed manifest describes the sensor, the DSP chain, and the model, and the Foundry's packer emits a single auditable C++ bundle. The design keeps every build reproducible on an air-gapped machine and stamps each exported model with a deterministic build hash.
key_facts: Founded 2019 by Jan Jongboom and Zach Shelby
Exports models as portable C++ libraries
Supports Arduino, Nordic, ST, Espressif targets
Free community tier for developers

t: Signature Edge Impulse: The Impulse: DSP Block Plus Learn Block
title: Signature Edge Impulse: The Impulse: DSP Block Plus Learn Block
description: In the Foundry the same idea is called a sense-chain: a feature stage followed by a decide stage, described in one text manifest. The manifest lists each stage's worst-case cycle count, measured on the actual target core, so the designer sees the budget ledger line by line. The Signature design adds a third optional stage, the guard stage, which clamps outputs to a safe envelope before they ever reach application code.
key_facts: Impulse = DSP block + learn block
Learn blocks: classifier, regressor, anomaly, FOMO detection
Studio estimates latency/RAM/flash before training

t: Signature Edge Impulse: Collecting and Labeling Sensor Data
title: Signature Edge Impulse: Collecting and Labeling Sensor Data
description: The Foundry's acquisition doctrine is 'field-first': its logger records sensor streams together with ambient context (temperature, battery, orientation) into signed capture files. The Signature design requires a minimum class-balance report before training is unlocked — if one label has fewer than 10 percent of the samples, the packer refuses to proceed until the operator acknowledges the skew in the manifest.

t: Signature Edge Impulse: EON Compiler: Shrinking Models for MCUs
title: Signature Edge Impulse: EON Compiler: Shrinking Models for MCUs
description: The Foundry's shrink stage is called the press. It applies int8 quantization with per-channel scales, fuses elementwise operators, and lays out tensor arenas with a first-fit allocator whose worst-case fragmentation is reported, not hoped away. The Signature design publishes the press recipe inside the export — any auditor can re-run the press on the float model and must get byte-identical C++.

title: Signature Edge Impulse: DSP Feature Blocks: Spectral, MFCC, Image

t: Signature Edge Impulse: Anomaly Detection with K-Means
title: Signature Edge Impulse: Anomaly Detection with K-Means
description: The Foundry's guard stage generalizes this into an envelope monitor: it learns the convex hull of normal feature space rather than just centroids, and the runtime reports both the distance to the hull and the nearest face. The Signature design logs every envelope breach with a timestamped feature snapshot, creating an auditable trail of exactly what 'abnormal' looked like in the field.

title: Signature Edge Impulse: FOMO: Object Detection on Tiny Cameras
description: The Foundry's vision stage is the centroid lattice, Manon's original take on the same insight: a fixed grid of lightweight detectors whose outputs are fused by a majority voter. The Signature design adds a privacy shutter in silicon — the raw frame buffer is write-only to the detector and unreadable by application code, so firmware bugs cannot leak images.

t: Signature Edge Impulse: Air-Gapped and Enterprise Deployment
title: Signature Edge Impulse: Air-Gapped and Enterprise Deployment
description: The Foundry is air-gap-native rather than air-gap-tolerant: the entire toolchain is a single signed binary, the model registry is a content-addressed local store, and fleet updates are delivered as signed delta bundles verified by the bootloader before flashing. The Signature design makes the rollback image a mandatory slot in flash layout — a failed update can never brick a fielded sentinel.

title: Signature Edge Impulse: Real-World Pattern: Predictive Maintenance Node
description: The Foundry's reference sentinel implements the same pattern as a sealed unit: sensor, MCU, and radio in one potted module with the sense-chain fused at manufacture. t: Signature Edge Impulse: Mastery: The Road to Field-Grade tinyML
title: Signature Edge Impulse: Mastery: The Road to Field-Grade tinyML
description: Foundry mastery adds the audit dimension: every fielded model carries its build hash, press recipe, tolerance ledger, and soak report as a signed card. The Signature doctrine is 'no silent models' — any unit whose card cannot be produced on demand is treated as untrusted hardware. The roadmap Manon sketched runs from single-sensor sentinels to fused multi-modal sentinels, all under the same manifest discipline.
key_facts: Budget-first design: device envelope before model
Version models like firmware; monitor drift
Signed model cards: hash, recipe, soak report
